title: PipelineSummaryResponse
description: A pipeline as returned by GET /api/pipelines, GET /api/pipelines/:id and the create/rename responses. `lastRun*` describe the latest non-dry run. `lastRunStepRowCounts` (HEL-1579) is that run's per-step row counts keyed by step id; it is omitted when not recorded (a never-run pipeline, a latest run that failed, was blocked or reaped, a Spark run, or a run that predates the column) and is never rendered as zero.

lastRunStepRowCounts.description: Step id to the number of rows that step produced in the latest run. Omitted or null when not recorded.
